areas.evidenceDecision: Real setup/update/service tests exercise verified assets, replacement failures, request budgets, saved default diagnostic precedence, package/plugin and preview ownership guards, and moved generated service paths without forcing custom definitions. Native plugin compatibility and system installers add checksum, metadata, native-support and failed-promotion checks; a compiled fixture with an isolated home and empty PATH verifies all frozen action verbs and canonical service ownership. Windows installer and macOS launchd execution remain platform CI evidence. Proposed installer-upgrade CI builds real native candidate archives and exercises latest-stable plugin installation, authenticated runtime/session migration and failed-checksum retention in isolated state. Herdr installs and upgrades use fake Herdr binaries, installers and servers: checksum and version checks precede replacement, a failed check restores the previous binary, newer and package-managed installs stay untouched, version-manager shims are never replaced, a newer or unidentified running server is never handed to the verified release, and live handoff is requested only for a Linux server proven to run outside any supervisor (a daemonized server in a scope; fake procfs cases include an operator-owned systemd unit and a wrapper parent; macOS is never proven), a v0.2.6 versioned legacy Windows Herdr is found off PATH and migrated, and install.ps1 release directories on PATH are recognized as official; otherwise the old server keeps running and a restart is reported. The installer-upgrade matrix runs the real candidate `herdr upgrade` against a compiled fake Herdr on each native platform to prove harness-integration installation and plugin tag pinning. This direct platform evidence is more useful than a model of OS packaging; OS service/channel upgrades and older release combinations remain excluded (docs/release.md).

Pure-function unit tests cover every anchor state, empty and partial witnesses, desk, pane and rolled-back move outcomes, conditional detach and kept-draft storage across tabs. Service tests cover Send revalidation against the saved board and start identity. Browser races at 1440 and 390 px cover late absence replies, two-client layout and draft conflicts. A model would restate these small pure rules, while real Herdr restart and ID reuse behaviour was verified only in throwaway sessions.
